business_summary: K.P. Energy Limited provides balance of plant solutions for renewable energy sector in India. It operates through Infrastructure Development, Sale of Power, and Operation & Maintenance Services segments. The company offers solutions for wind power and wind-solar hybrid power project development, which comprises site identification, meticulous site preparation, efficient construction and erection, seamless power evacuation, and ongoing operations and maintenance services, as well as engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning services. It has a portfolio of 48.5 MW operational renewable energy assets, including 37 MW of wind and 11.5 MW DC solar energy assets. K.P. Energy Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Surat, India.
